race.comment: OUTTA LINE (4) is the horse to beat after a luckless fourth at Warwick Farm, where she was sent out favourite, bumped at the start, held up from the 400m and steadied near the 200m yet was beaten only a length and a half. The 2kg weight relief and Tim Clark returning strengthen the case. Placed over this trip last time in and due for a change of luck. PAPPA BLUE (2) has to answer the 1800m question, but his Warwick Farm BM72 second two back was strong after a slow start and held-up in the straight. Eases from mid-week BM68 company and gets map favours. ALABAMA SHOWDOWN (1) is racing consistently, went under narrowly at Wyong and gets first-time blinkers, though 1800m is new. Keep safe. DANCE WITH DESTINY (7) rises from a Maiden win at this track into deeper BM64 grade, but her current campaign has been reliable and the track-and-trip win keeps her a live each-way chance.
